capability: Remove a lock-order deadlock by imposing one global acquisition order.
observed_failure:
test tests::two_transfers_apply has been running for over 60 seconds
no test result: the process is blocked in `Mutex::lock` on both threads
prompt_intro:
`run_pair` deadlocks. `transfer_a_to_b` and `transfer_b_to_a` each sleep
while holding their first lock, so two concurrent calls in opposite orders
block forever. Impose one acquisition order (for example, by comparing the
addresses of the two mutexes) so both helpers acquire in the same order
regardless of the direction of the transfer. Keep the public functions and
their effect: `run_pair(x, y, amount)` performs two a-to-b transfers and
returns the final balances.
provenance: original; authored for SELVEDGE P12.9/P11.21 (S14), no public benchmark text
